mapper.select: select count(*) from tb_weigh_info where work_proc_id = #{workProcId}

select c.item_cd ,d.item_name ,(select appearance from tb_item_detail where item_cd = c.item_cd ) as appearance ,c.phase ,ROUND(a.order_qty * ISNULL(c.real_content, 0) / 100,6) AS order_qty ,0 as weigh_qty ,0 as bag_weight ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.phase ORDER BY c.order_dist ) AS order_dist from TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC a inner join tb_bom_mst b on b.item_cd = a.item_cd inner join tb_bom_recipe c on c.bom_id = b.bom_id inner join tb_item_mst d on c.item_cd = d.item_cd where a.proc_cd = 'PRC001' and a.work_proc_id = #{workProcId} and b.default_yn = 'Y' order by c.phase, c.order_dist

select a.item_cd ,b.item_name ,c.appearance ,a.phase ,a.order_qty ,a.weigh_qty ,a.bag_weight ,a.test_no ,a.weigh_yn ,a.weigher ,a.confirmer ,a.weigh_id ,a.work_proc_id ,a.work_batch_id ,isnull(a.order_dist, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.phase ORDER BY a.order_dist) )) as order_dist ,(select STRING_AGG(test_no, ', ') from tb_weigh_inv where weigh_id = a.weigh_id) as testNoJoin from tb_weigh_info a inner join tb_item_mst b on a.item_cd = b.item_cd inner join tb_item_detail c on a.item_cd = c.item_cd where a.work_proc_id = #{workProcId} order by a.phase, a.order_dist
mapper.insert: insert into tb_weigh_info ( work_batch_id, work_proc_id, phase, item_cd, order_qty, weigh_qty, bag_weight, test_no, weigh_yn, weigher, confirmer , order_dist, reg_id, upd_id) values (#{workBatchId}, #{workProcId}, #{phase}, #{itemCd}, #{orderQty}, #{weighQty}, #{bagWeight}, #{testNo}, #{weighYn}, #{weigher}, #{confirmer} , #{orderDist}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select weigh_inv_id ,weigh_id ,storage_cd ,weigh_qty ,item_cd ,lot_no ,test_no from tb_weigh_inv where weigh_id = #{weighId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_weigh_inv (weigh_id, storage_cd, weigh_qty, item_cd, lot_no, test_no, reg_id, upd_id) VALUES (#{weighId}, #{storageCd}, #{weighQty}, #{itemCd}, #{lotNo}, #{testNo}, #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select a.item_cd ,c.item_type_cd ,c.item_name ,b.lot_no ,b.test_no ,c.expiry_date ,b.weigh_qty ,b.weigh_inv_id ,a.phase from tb_weigh_info a inner join tb_weigh_inv b on a.weigh_id = b.weigh_id inner join tb_item_mst c on c.item_cd = a.item_cd where a.work_proc_id = #{workProcId}

select d.code_nm as tranTypeName ,a.tran_date ,s.storage_name ,a.test_no ,a.qty ,c.make_no ,b.item_cd ,m.item_name from vw_inv_stock_tran a left join TB_WORK_ORDER_PROC b on b.out_tran_id = a.tran_id left join TB_WORK_ORDER_BATCH c on c.work_batch_id =b.work_batch_id left join tb_common_code d on d.com_type_cd = 'TRAN_CD' and d.code = a.tran_type_cd left join tb_storage_mst s on s.storage_cd = a.storage_cd left join tb_item_mst m on m.item_cd = b.item_cd where a.tran_type_cd not in ('L', 'J') and a.item_cd = #{itemCd} and a.tran_date between #{strDate} and #{endDate}
